description:
Fantom Corporation is a mission-focused organization supporting critical programs across the defense and intelligence community. We partner with our customers to deliver high-impact technical solutions while fostering a culture built on trust, expertise, and long-term career growth.
We are seeking a Software Engineer to support the full Operations and Maintenance (O&M) software lifecycle for mission-critical enterprise applications. This role is responsible for developing, maintaining, testing, and enhancing secure web applications while supporting cloud infrastructure, DevSecOps processes, and modern software development practices.
The ideal candidate has experience with ServiceNow development, JavaScript-based web technologies, .NET development, cloud platforms, and enterprise application support within secure government environments. This position works closely with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, secure, and accessible applications that support mission objectives.

Responsibilities

 Participate in Lean Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily standups, and retrospectives

 Collaborate with product owners, engineers, operations, cybersecurity, and testing teams to deliver scalable software solutions

 Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack enterprise applications

 Build modern Single Page Applications (SPAs) using React, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript

 Develop RESTful APIs and backend services using Node.js, Express, or comparable frameworks

 Design, implement, and optimize enterprise search solutions using Elasticsearch

 Develop AI-powered search capabilities, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and semantic search solutions

 Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) into enterprise applications to enhance search, knowledge retrieval, and user workflows

 Design and implement data ingestion pipelines supporting search indexing, document chunking, embeddings, and vector search

 Develop detailed technical designs, interface specifications, and supporting documentation

 Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business and mission requirements into technical solutions

 Perform unit testing, integration testing, and code reviews to ensure software quality and reliability

 Track vendor software releases, upgrades, and patch management activities

 Utilize DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines to automate software development, testing, and deployment

 Support cloud-native application development within AWS, Azure, or similar cloud environments


Required Qualifications

 Must be fully cleared with a recent polygraph 

 Experience working in Lean Agile software development environments

 Experience developing enterprise software applications throughout the full software development lifecycle

 Experience building AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, or AI-assisted retrieval systems

 Experience translating customer requirements into scalable technical designs

 Experience designing system interfaces and application architectures

 Experience developing modern Single Page Applications (SPAs) using React, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript

 Experience developing RESTful APIs using Node.js, Express, or similar backend frameworks

 Experience troubleshooting web technologies, web services, SSL, and internet-based application protocols

 Experience with automated testing frameworks such as Jest or Karma

 Experience using DevOps tools including Git, Jenkins, Nexus, or similar CI/CD platforms

 Experience designing, deploying, and tuning Elasticsearch environments, including indexing strategies, querying, relevance optimization, and scalability

 Experience designing or implementing data pipelines supporting search, document ingestion, embeddings, vector search, and RAG workflows

 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills


Desired Qualifications

 Recent experience supporting Agile development within Intelligence Community or other secure government environments

 Experience evaluating, selecting, and integrating commercial or open-source Large Language Models into enterprise applications

 Experience with vector databases, hybrid search architectures, semantic search, and relevance optimization

 Experience leading technical teams or mentoring engineers on AI, search technologies, and modern software engineering best practices

 Experience with cloud-native architectures and enterprise AI platforms

 Experience developing scalable knowledge management or enterprise search platforms

 #CJ


Fantom Corp is a Software Development, Agile Cloud, Cyber Security (Risk Management, Assessments & Authorization (A&A)), Data, AI Platform (Computer Vision Models), Podcasting Media Services, and IT Services provider. Established in 2015, Fantom Corp serves Federal customers with top-notch Cybersecurity Architects, Data Scientists/Analysts, Software Engineers/Developers, DevSecOps Engineers, Project Managers, Identity, Credential Access Management (ICAM) services , and Cloud-certified practitioners. We excel in delivering emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) with a focus on identifying trends, object detection, and classification of structured and unstructured data. Fantom Corp possesses mastery in all aspects of digital audio production. We lead in the ideation and creation of efforts for clients who want to harness the power of podcasting. We guide them in selecting the right show format for their needs and goals. As a Small Business, we possess the innovation, speed and flexibility to meet your requirements.
